description:
Celebrity acupuncture has exploded across Hollywood, with actors, musicians, and influencers such as Lady Gaga, Kim Kardashian, Jennifer Aniston, Matt Damon, and Robert Downey Jr. promoting it. They see it as an ancient path to healing, balance, and wellness. But as acupuncture becomes a celebrity staple, we must ask the underlying question: is acupuncture really scientifically proven? Or is there a spiritual force behind the needles, one that has a dark side to it that no one seems to discuss?
